name: open-cowork-chrome-extension

scripts.build:cockpit: cd cockpit && npm run db:generate && npm run db:apply && npx next build
scripts.dev:cockpit: cd cockpit && npm run db:generate && npx next dev -H 127.0.0.1
scripts.dev:events: cd mini-services/cowork-events && npx tsx watch index.ts
scripts.build:all: npm run build:extension && npm run build:cockpit
scripts.bootstrap: npm ci --prefix cockpit && npm ci --prefix mini-services/cowork-events

description: Open-source agentic browser control Chrome extension
